candidate_relations.reason: Bednar tumor (pigmented dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans) is characterized by CD34 positivity and often S100 negativity, but the clinical record describes a tumor with Melan-A and HMB-45 positivity and S100 negativity, which is more consistent with Clear Cell Sarcoma. The morphology of spindle to epithelioid cells with prominent nucleoli and atypical mitoses also points away from Bednar tumor.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Bednar tumor vs Clear Cell Sarcoma
